subsistence-agriculture.def: Farming mainly to feed the farmer's own family, with little left to sell, as on small rice plots in rural Bangladesh.

commercial-agriculture.def: Farming mainly to sell crops and animals for profit, as on soybean farms in Mato Grosso, Brazil.

monocropping.def: Growing the same crop on the same field year after year. Monoculture, a close term, means growing one crop over a large area.

bid-rent-theory.def: The idea that land users bid for land with the best access to a market, so land costs more near the market and the use that can pay the most at each distance gets the land.
